mcq_fix.s: According to classical (Greek and Latin) accounts, Chandragupta Maurya's army consisted of

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Asiatic Society / colonial Indology

patterns: PYQs are one-liners on identity/name pairs: Vishnugupta = Chanakya, Sandrocottus = Chandragupta (William Jones, Justin), Deimachus under Bindusara.
Megasthenes (envoy of Seleucus to Chandragupta, Indica) is the most repeated fact; Sudarshana lake/Girnar built under Chandragupta (Pushyagupta) via Rudradaman's Junagadh inscription.
APPSC tilt: Chandragupta first king to abdicate, Bhadrabahu as his Jain guru, Megasthenes first to mention Andhra forts.
Mudrarakshasa (Vishakhadatta) as source on Chandragupta recurs.
App MCQs are mostly sound but add multi-statement items (Taxila revolts, southern edicts) beyond PYQ depth.
